verdict.rationale: Productboard documents a public REST API v2. The docs cover CRUD and search across feedback, documents, customers and product hierarchy entities, plus cursor pagination, field control, configuration endpoints for discovering the schema, and webhooks. Authentication options are documented (personal access tokens, OAuth, and DCR/PKCE for MCP clients), along with a quickstart and Postman guide; a probe confirmed agent-friendly docs via llms.txt with .md pages. Missing for 10: a publicly discoverable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404) and independent hands-on corroboration of API use.
